title: WebLogic wls9_async exploitation indicators (CVE-2019-2725)
text: Scanning and exploitation of CVE-2019-2725 continues against exposed Oracle WebLogic consoles. Crafted SOAP requests to _async/AsyncResponseService trigger deserialization and command execution. Observed payloads are mixed: coin miners predominate, but some operators delivered ransomware loaders. Severity looks critical where the admin or async endpoints are internet-reachable; internal-only deployments are lower risk. Indicators: POSTs to /_async/ or /wls-wsat/ paths with serialized Java in the body, and WebLogic spawning PowerShell, certutil, or wget. Recommended: apply Oracle's out-of-band patch, restrict the async endpoints, and check for unauthorized scheduled tasks and miner processes.
